remoteClasses.name: MoqPublisherEndpoint
remoteClasses.doc:
Endpoint that publishes a Kurento media stream to a Media over QUIC (MoQ) relay.

MoqPublisherEndpoint accepts audio and video from the Kurento media pipeline, encodes them, and publishes the resulting CMAF stream to a MoQ relay under the broadcast name specified at construction time. From there, any MoQ-capable subscriber (browser, CDN edge node, another MoqSubscriberEndpoint, …) can consume the live stream.

Under the hood the element uses the moqsink GStreamer element provided by the moq-gst plugin. The endpoint internally encodes the incoming media to H.264/AAC before feeding it to the CMAF muxer inside moqsink.

Usage


  # JavaScript (Kurento Client)
  let publisher = await pipeline.create('MoqPublisherEndpoint', {
    url: 'https://relay.example.com',
    broadcast: 'my-broadcast.hang'
  });
  await webRtcEndpoint.connect(publisher);
  await publisher.publish();

Events fired

  • Error: A transport or encoding error occurred.

params.name: url
params.doc: URL of the MoQ relay where the stream will be published. Example: https://relay.example.com

params.name: broadcast
params.doc: Name under which the broadcast will be announced. Example: my-stream.hang

properties.name: url
properties.doc: URL of the MoQ relay this endpoint is publishing to.

properties.name: broadcast
properties.doc: Name of the broadcast being published.

methods.name: publish
methods.doc: Start encoding and publishing media to the MoQ relay.

methods.name: unpublish
methods.doc: Stop publishing; tears down the connection to the MoQ relay.
